info.title: Facilito API
info.description:
The Facilito API lets you manage your business catalog, customers, staff, locations, inventory, and sales. It is organized around REST, accepts JSON request bodies, and returns JSON responses with standard HTTP methods and status codes.

Send a bearer access token in the Authorization header with each request. Your authenticated account identifies the merchant whose data you can access and the permissions available to you.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Inspect the identity claims associated with the authenticated account.

tags.name: Onboarding
tags.description: Set up a business in Facilito. Create a merchant and its first location, and assign the current account as the business owner.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Create and manage merchant products, including items and services.

tags.name: Collections
tags.description: Create and manage collections that organize merchant products.

get.description: Returns the identity claims from the authenticated bearer token.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired. Returns invalid_oauth_token.

post.description: Creates a merchant and its first location, and makes the current account the business owner. If the account already owns a business, returns the existing merchant without changing its details. An account that belongs to a staff member cannot create a business. Requires a valid bearer token; existing merchant membership is not required.

200.description: Returns the merchant object for the new or existing business.

400.description: The request contains invalid JSON or one or more invalid values. Returns `validation_error`.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired. Returns invalid_oauth_token.

404.description: The account could not be found. Returns `resource_not_found`.

409.description: The account belongs to a staff member, or a conflicting change prevents the account from being updated. Returns `conflict_error`. Also returned for idempotency_key_mismatch or idempotency_request_in_progress when Idempotency-Key is supplied.

500.description: An unexpected error prevented the request from completing. Returns `internal_server_error`.

403.description: The account has no provisioned membership, or its employee is invited or disabled. Returns `account_not_provisioned` or `forbidden_error`.

post.description: Creates a draft item or an active service with one default variant, included in the response. Items require unit_cost greater than zero, and item price must be equal to or greater than unit_cost. Items start with zero stock at every merchant location. Services have no inventory records and store unit_cost as "0.00" and SKU and barcode as null, ignoring supplied values after request validation. Optional images are stored as external HTTP or HTTPS URLs. Names may repeat; slugs are unique within the merchant. SKU and barcode values remain reserved by archived products. All records are saved in one transaction. Requires an enabled owner or staff membership, resolved from the database using the authenticated account. Token membership metadata does not determine access.

201.description: Returns the created product and its default variant. Items start as draft; services start as active.

400.description: The request contains invalid JSON or invalid field values, an item is missing unit_cost or has zero unit_cost, or an item's price is below its unit_cost. Returns validation_error or price_below_unit_cost, respectively.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired. Returns invalid_oauth_token.

403.description: The account has no provisioned membership (account_not_provisioned), or its employee is invited or disabled (forbidden_error).

404.description: The collection does not exist or does not belong to the current merchant. Returns resource_not_found with message `Collection {collectionId} has not been found.`.

409.description: The SKU or barcode is already used within this merchant, including by archived products. Returns sku_already_exists or barcode_already_exists. Also returned for idempotency_key_mismatch or idempotency_request_in_progress when Idempotency-Key is supplied.

500.description: An unexpected error prevented creation. All product records are rolled back. Returns internal_server_error.

post.description: Records the sale, lines, payments and location transaction number atomically. Sale IDs are generated by the server. Fulfilled physical lines deduct inventory and record movements at server time; services skip inventory. Any stock shortage defers all inventory operations for the whole sale, preserving current stock and recording only deficits on the lines. Web shortages are rejected when allowBackorders is false; Android and iOS always record these as pending. Missing inventory counts as zero. Requires enabled membership; staff also need checkout permission and location access. Staff price reductions and explicit discounts require apply_discounts, and each line’s compounded discount must stay within maxDiscountRate. Owners bypass the cap, but final prices must never be below unit cost. Tax is ignored. Discounted line totals and converted dollar payments round to cents, half up, before summing. Payments must exactly match the sale total. The location exchange rate is copied to dollar payments; a zero rate contributes zero to the paid total. Pending-sale reconciliation is handled separately.

201.description: The saved fulfilled or pending sale.

400.description: Invalid fields, duplicate variants, inactive catalog entries, a final price below cost, or payment mismatch. Returns validation_error, price_below_unit_cost, or payment_insufficient.

401.description: Missing or invalid bearer token.

403.description: Membership, checkout permission, location access, discount permission or discount cap prevents checkout.

404.description: Location, variant or optional customer is not found within this merchant.

409.description: Insufficient web stock with backorders disabled or exhausted location numbering. Returns stock_insufficient or conflict_error. Also returned for idempotency_key_mismatch or idempotency_request_in_progress when Idempotency-Key is supplied.

500.description: Unexpected persistence error. All transaction effects are rolled back.

get.description: Returns full sales, including line items and payments, ordered by created_at descending and then id descending. All statuses are included unless filtered. Pass next_cursor as cursor with the same filters to continue. Enabled owners can read all sales for their merchant. Enabled staff need view_transactions permission and may read only assigned locations.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of sales to return. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value returned by the previous page.

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: Filter by location id. Unknown or inaccessible IDs return an empty page.

parameters.name: customer_id
parameters.description: Filter by customer id. Unknown or inaccessible IDs return an empty page.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on business_date. ISO 8601 timestamp with an explicit timezone. Either bound may be omitted; from must not exceed to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on business_date. ISO 8601 timestamp with an explicit timezone. Either bound may be omitted; from must not exceed to.

200.description: Returns a page of sales and pagination information.

400.description: Invalid filters, limit, cursor, timestamps, or reversed date range. Returns validation_error.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired. Returns `invalid_oauth_token`.

403.description: Membership is not provisioned, employee access is not enabled, or staff lack view_transactions permission. Returns account_not_provisioned or forbidden_error.

500.description: An unexpected error prevented the sales from being listed. Returns `internal_server_error`.

post.description: Voids a fulfilled sale atomically, restores its physical quantities to the original location, and records inverse inventory movements linked to the sale. A void is rejected when any physical product has been restocked since the sale was created. Original payments remain as sale history; no refund is issued. Enabled owners may void sales. Enabled staff need void_sales permission and access to the sale's location. Repeated requests return the original void metadata without restoring stock again.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The sale identifier.

200.description: The voided sale, including its original payments and void metadata.

400.description: The reason is invalid, the sale is not fulfilled, or a product was restocked at or after the sale was created. Returns validation_error.

401.description: Missing or invalid bearer token.

403.description: Membership, void permission, employee status, or sale-location access prevents voiding.

404.description: The sale does not exist within this merchant.

409.description: Concurrent inventory changes prevented the void from completing. Returns concurrent_update_conflict. Also returned for idempotency_key_mismatch or idempotency_request_in_progress when Idempotency-Key is supplied.

500.description: Unexpected persistence error. All void effects are rolled back.

get.description: Returns the full sale, including line items, payments, customer, creator, and void metadata. Enabled owners can read all sales for their merchant. Enabled staff need view_transactions permission and may read only assigned locations.

404.description: The sale is missing, belongs to another merchant, or is at a location the staff member cannot access. Returns resource_not_found.

500.description: An unexpected error prevented the sale from being retrieved. Returns `internal_server_error`.

RateLimitExceeded.description: Too many requests. Wait for the duration in the Retry-After header before trying again. Returns `rate_limit_exceeded`.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests allowed during the current window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the current rate limit window resets.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.

IdempotencyConflict.description: The key belongs to a different request (idempotency_key_mismatch), or the matching request is unfinished (idempotency_request_in_progress). No operation is executed. An unfinished request may have completed its effects without saving its response; check its result before starting a new operation.

IdempotencyUnavailable.description: Idempotency lookup or claim is unavailable, or the stored record is invalid. The operation is not executed. Retry with the same key. Redis failures in the preceding rate limiter reach the generic error handler and return 500. If saving a response fails after execution, the operation response is returned and the surviving claim stays blocked until expiry.

AccountType.description: The role of an account within Facilito. Identifies a merchant owner, a staff member, or an internal account.

code.description: A stable code that identifies the failure. Use this value for programmatic error handling. Account lookup and updates report resource_not_found for missing accounts, validation_error for invalid account update payloads, rate_limit_exceeded for identity provider throttling, and conflict_error for conflicting account updates. Identity provider authentication and service failures report internal_server_error.

message.description: A human-readable explanation of the failure. Use `code`, rather than the message wording, to identify the error.
examples: Not enough stock for East Blue Tangerines at Water 7.

code.description: The code that identifies this individual issue.

message.description: A human-readable explanation of this individual issue.

field.description: The field associated with the issue, expressed as a dot-separated path that can include array indices. Omitted when the issue is not associated with a field.

details.description: The individual validation or business-rule issues associated with the failure. An empty array indicates that no further details are available.

BusinessError.description: A failure caused by a business rule or an unsuccessful operation. Use `code` to identify the failure and `details` to inspect individual issues. The `FacilitoError` contract adds request and HTTP status information.

Collection.description: A group of related products in a merchant catalog. Use collections to organize products into categories, such as provisions or clothing. A product includes the identifier and name of its associated collection.

CountryIsoCode.description: A supported country code in lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format. The value `zz` represents an unspecified country.

CurrencyCode.description: A supported currency code in lowercase ISO 4217 format. The value `xxx` represents an unspecified currency.

accountType.description: The role of the authenticated account within Facilito.

CurrentUser.description: The authenticated account and its business context. Links the account to a merchant and an employee profile, and identifies its account role.

name.description: The display name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer. Returns `null` if none is recorded.

phone.description: The contact phone number of the customer. Returns `null` if none is recorded.

updated_at.description: The date and time when the customer was last updated, in RFC 3339 format.

Customer.description: A person or business that purchases from a merchant. Stores the customer name and contact details. Sales can reference the customer to identify who made a purchase.

Decimal.description: A non-negative decimal value represented as a string, with up to two fractional digits. Used for amounts and rates without relying on binary floating-point representation. Zero is allowed.

PositiveDecimal.description: A decimal value greater than zero, represented as a string with up to two fractional digits. Uses the same format as `Decimal`, but excludes zero.

name.description: The display name of the employee.

isOwner.description: Whether the employee is the owner of the merchant.

posAccessStatus.description: The access state of the employee at the point of sale: invited, enabled, or disabled.

permissions.description: The distinct point-of-sale capabilities assigned to the employee.

id.description: The identifier of the linked account.

email.description: The email address of the linked account.

account.description: The sign-in account linked to the employee. Returns `null` if no account is linked.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the employee was created, in RFC 3339 format.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the employee was last updated, in RFC 3339 format.

maxDiscountRate.description: Maximum effective line discount as a fraction. 0.10 means 10%. Defaults to 0.00. Owners are exempt.

Employee.description: A staff member associated with a merchant. Describes their ownership status, point-of-sale access, permissions, and linked sign-in account. Sales, purchase orders, and stock records reference employees to identify who recorded an operation.

code.description: A stable code that identifies the failure. Use this value for programmatic error handling.

message.description: A human-readable explanation of the failure. Use `code`, rather than the message wording, to identify the error.
examples: Not enough stock for East Blue Tangerines at Water 7.

message.description: A human-readable explanation of this individual issue.

field.description: The field associated with the issue, expressed as a dot-separated path that can include array indices. Omitted when the issue is not associated with a field.

details.description: The individual validation or business-rule issues associated with the failure. An empty array indicates that no further details are available.

request_id.description: The identifier of the request associated with the error. Use this value when investigating a failed request.

status.description: The HTTP status code associated with the error.

FacilitoError.description: An error associated with an API request. Contains the HTTP status, request identifier, and business error details. Use `code` to handle the failure in your application and `request_id` to identify the request when investigating it.

InventoryChangeType.description: The kind of entry in stock history. A `movement` records a relative quantity change; a `physical_count` records an observed absolute quantity.

variantId.description: The identifier of the product variant associated with the stock entry.

locationId.description: The identifier of the location associated with the stock entry.

referenceId.description: The identifier of the related business record, such as a sale or purchase order. Returns `null` when no related record is associated.

reason.description: The business reason for the inventory movement.

fromState.description: The inventory state from which the stock moved.

toState.description: The inventory state to which the stock moved.

quantityDelta.description: The signed change in stock quantity. Positive values add stock; negative values remove stock.

unitCost.description: The cost per unit captured for the movement, expressed as a decimal string.

name.description: The display name of the employee.

createdBy.description: The employee who recorded the stock entry.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the inventory movement was created, in RFC 3339 format.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the inventory movement was last updated, in RFC 3339 format.

oneOf.description: A change to the stock of a product variant at a location. Records the quantity delta, inventory states, unit cost, and employee responsible for the entry. A reference identifier can link the movement to a related sale or purchase order.

variantId.description: The identifier of the product variant associated with the stock entry.

InventoryChange.description: An entry in the stock history of a product variant at a location. Read `type` to determine whether the entry contains an inventory movement or a physical count. Movements describe quantity changes; physical counts describe observed quantities.

id.description: The identifier of the inventory level.

InventoryLevel.description: The stock held for one product variant at one location. Connects the variant to the location and includes its current quantity, low-stock threshold, and replenishment target.

InventoryMovementReason.description: The reason for a stock movement. Identifies a sale, purchase, reversal, loss, damage, theft, or correction.

id.description: The identifier of the inventory movement.

variantId.description: The identifier of the product variant associated with the stock entry.

locationId.description: The identifier of the location associated with the stock entry.

referenceId.description: The identifier of the related business record, such as a sale or purchase order. Returns `null` when no related record is associated.

reason.description: The business reason for the inventory movement.

fromState.description: The inventory state from which the stock moved.

unitCost.description: The cost per unit captured for the movement, expressed as a decimal string.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional client-generated key, scoped to the authenticated user across all POST endpoints. Use a UUID v4 or another unique opaque string. Matching retries replay the original status and body, including handler errors except validation_error responses. Validation errors are not saved, including those returned by the handler; their claim is released so a corrected request can reuse the key. The actual URL path, query values, and parsed JSON must match. JSON whitespace and query parameter name order do not matter. JSON object field order, array order, repeated query value order, and JSON value types must match. Authentication, rate limits, membership checks, and request validation run before lookup. Validation failures do not claim a key. Keys expire 24 hours after the first valid request claims them; retries and completion do not extend expiry. Unfinished requests remain blocked until expiry. After expiry, reuse can execute again. Avoid sensitive information in keys.
